about.body: The B38 is BMW's turbocharged 1.5-litre inline-three petrol engine, in production since 2013 as part of BMW's modular engine family. It's the smallest engine in the current BMW range, fitted across three model lines: the 1 Series (F20/F21, 116i, 2015–2019), the X1 (F48, sDrive16i/sDrive18i, 2015–2022), and the X2 (F39, sDrive16i/sDrive18i, 2017–2023). As a three-cylinder engine, it's the entry point to BMW's petrol line-up, and a relatively straightforward rebuild compared to the more complex six-cylinder and V8 engines in our workshop.

byModel.body: The B38 appears across three model lines in the BMW range, all in the sDrive (front-wheel-drive) configuration. In the 1 Series (F20/F21, 2015–2019), it powers the 116i as the entry-level petrol option. In the X1 (F48, 2015–2022), it powers the sDrive16i and sDrive18i variants. In the X2 (F39, 2017–2023), it powers the sDrive16i and sDrive18i variants. All B38 applications are standard petrol, with no MHEV or PHEV configurations using this engine code in the BMW range.

compatibility.body: Because the B38 is fitted across three different models — the 1 Series, X1 and X2 — with different chassis, mounting configurations and ancillaries, compatibility isn't automatic. A B38 from a 1 Series isn't a direct replacement for a B38 from an X1 or X2. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm your exact vehicle by registration or VIN.
